title: Distinct Oracle control states
statement: An oracle nondeterministic Turing machine is well formed when its query state differs from each of its positive-answer and negative-answer states, and those two answer states differ from one another.
hypotheses_covered: The query state differs from the positive-answer state
The query state differs from the negative-answer state
The positive-answer and negative-answer states differ
